a.lede: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.
a.title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny

b.lede: The spy who targeted NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang was reportedly a recruit by China's version of the CIA. US officials say Huang was romantically involved with her.
b.title: China's main intelligence agency reportedly recruited the spy who targeted NVIDIA's CEO
